trial_name: Prospective Comparison of ARNI with ARB Global Outcomes in HF with Preserved Ejection Fraction

primary_publication.citation: Solomon SD et al. Angiotensin-Neprilysin Inhibition in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction. N Engl J Med 2019;381:1609-1620
primary_publication.selection_criterion: Reports the pre-specified primary outcome of the registered trial. Secondary publications and subgroup analyses are not the source for this table.

condition: heart failure, NYHA class II to IV, left ventricular ejection fraction 45% or higher within the preceding 6 months, elevated natriuretic peptides, structural heart disease, prior diuretic use, age 50 years or older
intervention: sacubitril-valsartan, target dose 97 mg sacubitril with 103 mg valsartan twice daily
comparator: valsartan, target dose 160 mg twice daily

population.exclusion_reason: one site closed on 2017-06-27 for serious Good Clinical Practice violation; 12 patients in the sacubitril-valsartan arm and 14 in the valsartan arm excluded from all efficacy analyses

source.location: Results, Enrollment, Randomization, and Follow-up; Figure 1

statistical_analysis_plan.alpha_note: final two-sided threshold, adjusted for the interim analysis
statistical_analysis_plan.gatekeeping: Secondary hypotheses are tested confirmatorily only if the primary hypothesis is rejected. The renal composite is among the gated secondary hypotheses.

outcomes.measure: total hospitalisations for heart failure and death from cardiovascular causes
renal composite: 50% or greater decrease in estimated glomerular filtration rate, development of end-stage renal disease, or death from renal causes

adverse_events.scope_declaration: Table 3 of the primary publication reports ONLY the pre-specified adverse events of interest, selected for the known safety profile of angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibition. It is not a list of the most frequent adverse events. Overall adverse event and serious adverse event frequencies are in Supplementary Appendix Tables S5 and S6 and are NOT included in this table. A summary generated from this table cannot report overall adverse event frequency.

potassium.reason: number of patients with an assessed potassium measurement

events.term: hypotension, systolic blood pressure below 100 mmHg

source.location: Methods, Trial Outcomes; Results, Safety; Table 3

eligibility_source.location: Methods, Trial Patients; Supplementary Appendix Table S1
